profile.headline: .NET & Database Developer at State Corporation Commission
profile.summary:
Debbie is a well-rounded .NET developer with exceptional skills in relational database design and programming.  Hands-on development in both C# and VB programming, .NET 2.0 thru the current, both web applications, and desktop applications.  Most recent adventure is using Blazor, Entity Framework, .NET 2022, .Net Core, WebAPI.  Experience working on an application using dotNetStoreFront, several Content Management Systems.  Single-handedly built www.bookadayroom.com - an international hotel reservation website with foreign currency and multiple times zones.  Other skills include SQL Server, Oracle, Microsoft Access, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, Knockout, XML, Vue.js.

Debbie is a summa cum laude graduate of VA Tech with a B.S. degree in Math Education and Computer Science, and later completed an Associates from ECPI in Web Development.  Over the years, she has been a Teacher, Entrepreneur, Relational Database Consultant at the National level, and .NET Developer.  As a database consultant, she was a member of the elite "BRAT" team at Honeywell, and assigned to the National Accounts division where she provided relational database expertise to clients such as General Electric, Honeywell, Ford, Deloitte and Touche, Graybar, and Shaw Carpet.   As President of DBA Consulting, she developed a barcode application and helped several hundred auto recyclers add barcodes and scanners to their warehouses and inventory systems.  More recently, she has served as Director of Technology and Operations for Two Rivers Capital Management in Williamsburg.  Now she is happily back doing .NET development, with relational database.

Specialties: .NET application development (both C# and VB, both web and desktop), Relational database design and SQL programming, Customer technical support and troubleshooting, Technical sales support, Teacher/trainer.

NOTE TO RECRUITERS: Emails are appreciated but not connection requests or phone calls.  Thanks.

CONTACT INFO: debdba@verizon.net
